data.name: Damage Reduction
data.description: The stalwart defender gains DR %1/-. Damage reduction from different sources does not stack; however, a stalwart defender of 5th or higher level that gains DR from armor (but not from any other source) increases his class-based DR by the value of the armor's DR.|DamageReductionLVL
